data.gender_notes: Ameeraat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A commander of men, a leader, a princess, a noblewoman, a queen. The name Ameeraat carries the meaning “Princess, Commander, Ruler” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ameeraat usually hope their child will grow to embody princess, commander, ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A soul that embodies leadership and strength, a warrior of faith
data.etymology: Ameeraat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Princess, Commander, Ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ameeraat total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: أميرات
in_arabic.long_meaning: أميرات: هي جمع للمصدر امير، وهو من أسماء الله الحسنى، ويجمعها بالفتح لِأَنّها اسماء مذكر جمع، تعني الملكية والسلطنة والحكم، وبالتالي فهي اسم عالي المستوى في الإسلام، ويُستخدم هذا الاسم في القرآن الكريم في سورة النور، آيات 31، ويعتبر من الأسماء القديمة في الإسلام، ويستخدم أيضاً في الحديث الشريف

in_urdu.name: امیرات
in_urdu.meaning: امیرات، مرات، امیروں کی حامدہ، خاتون، ملکہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: امیرات کا معنی ہے بادشاہی، سلطنت، حاکمیت، اور ملکیت ہے، یہ نام قرآن میں بھی ذکر کیا گیا ہے، سورة النور، آیت 31، اور یہ نام قدیم اسلامی ناموں میں سے ہے

in_hindi.name: अमीरात
in_hindi.long_meaning: अमीरात का अर्थ है राज्य, सलतनत, शासन, और अधिकार है | यह नाम कुरान में भी उल्लेखित है | सूरह नूर, आयत 31 | यह नाम प्राचीन इस्लामी नामों में से है

in_pashto.name: امیرات
in_pashto.long_meaning: امیرات دا معنا بادشاهي، سلطنت، حاکمیت، او ملکیت ځایځي، دا نوم قرآن کریم کې هم ذکر کړایښت دی، سورې نور، آیت 31، او دا نوم پخوانی اسلامي نومونو کې یو څوک دی

in_english.name: Ameeraat
in_english.long_meaning: Ameeraat, meaning princess, queen, monarch, ruler, noblewoman, is a Quranic name with roots in Arabic, it is mentioned in the Quran in Surah Nur, verse 31, and has been used in Islamic history, it signifies power, nobility, and royalty, associated with positive traits such as wisdom and kindness.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Ameeraat" carries a sense of power, leadership, and nobility. In Islamic culture, the name can be given to a girl, signifying her potential to become a strong, influential, and respected leader. The name reflects the historical role of women in Islam, who have held positions of power and influence throughout the history of the religion. For example, the Prophet Muhammad's wives were not just family members but also political and diplomatic figures in their own right.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Ameeraat" can be seen as a reminder of the potential for greatness that lies within each person. It can serve as a motivation for personal growth, striving to become a leader in one's own life, as well as a model of compassion, kindness, and wisdom for others. The name also reflects the concept of khilafah (the divine caliphate) - every believer is a representative and leader of God on earth, responsible for spreading His message and creating a just and compassionate society.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Princess, Commander, Ruler" symbolizes A commander of men, a leader, a princess, a noblewoman, a queen. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Ameeraat serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of princess, commander, ruler.
